output.reason: [ev-dd988a5ed5c3] is one step in an upgrade guide ("Update your provider manifests to use v2 versions"). It says that v2 providers support both kinds of managed resource and that existing cluster-scoped MRs "continue working unchanged". It does not say what fails, is rejected or must be migrated if an operator keeps pre-v2 providers on Crossplane 2.0.0. So the proposed migration-required kind, and its claim that the update is needed "to ensure compatibility", go beyond what the evidence states. To settle the consequence, we need evidence on whether pre-v2 providers still work with Crossplane 2.0.0, or whether the upgrade fails or breaks without the provider upgrade.
